task: Write a Python function that extracts the AWS region from an S3 bucket URI (e.g., 's3://my-bucket-us-east-1/path/to/file'). The region appears after the last hyphen in the bucket name.
Create a JSON object that represents an AWS IAM policy allowing read-only access to a specific S3 bucket named 'my-data-bucket'. Include the necessary Action, Resource, and Effect fields.
Write a regular expression that matches valid AWS EC2 instance IDs. Instance IDs follow the pattern 'i-' followed by exactly 17 hexadecimal characters (e.g., 'i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8').
